title: pilosella caespitosa subsp. uechtritzii
intro: Pilosella caespitosa subsp. uechtritzii, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family, is a subspecies of Pilosella caespitosa. It is a perennial plant with medicinal properties, traditionally used in folk medicine. The health benefits of Pilosella caespitosa subsp. uechtritzii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
